issues.id: display:How big the triangles are: min(R, h)^2 / 2 of the coarsest triangle a dent lands on. The slope bound keeps the smooth field injective, but the mesh is flat triangles; this and 'min gap' bound how far a triangle's chord may stray from it. Either at 0 turns the guard off.
issues.english: How big the triangles are: min(R, h)^2 / 2 of the coarsest triangle a dent lands on. The slope bound keeps the smooth field injective, but the mesh is flat triangles; this and 'min gap' bound how far a triangle's chord may stray from it. Either at 0 turns the guard off.
issues.translation: Размер треугольников: min(R, h)^2 / 2 самого грубого треугольника под вмятиной. Ограничение наклона сохраняет инъективность гладкого поля, но сетка состоит из плоских граней; этот параметр и минимальный зазор ограничивают отклонение хорды. Любой ноль отключает защиту.
issues.assessment: zero rendered as a word in the target language

issues.id: display:How thin the walls are: the smallest distance from a skin to whatever sits behind it. Either this or 'chord factor' at 0 turns the guard off.
issues.english: How thin the walls are: the smallest distance from a skin to whatever sits behind it. Either this or 'chord factor' at 0 turns the guard off.
issues.translation: Толщина стенок: минимальный зазор от обшивки до объекта за ней. Ноль здесь или у коэффициента хорды отключает защиту.

translations.pt-BR: Propelente sólido armazenável de alto empuxo, adequado a grandes motores-foguete sólidos.

semantic_samples.english: Curved slots deliver a hard kick until their fins burn through, leaving a large low-thrust port.

translations.fr-FR: Les rainures courbes donnent une forte poussée initiale jusqu'à la combustion des ailettes, puis laissent un large canal à faible poussée.
translations.it-IT: Le scanalature curve producono una forte spinta iniziale finché le alette non bruciano, lasciando poi un ampio canale a bassa spinta.
translations.es-ES: Las ranuras curvas generan un gran empuje inicial hasta consumirse sus aletas; después queda un conducto amplio de bajo empuje.
translations.pt-BR: As ranhuras curvas fornecem forte empuxo inicial até as aletas queimarem, deixando depois um canal amplo de baixo empuxo.
